spec.text: Image 1 is the couple in their registration-day outfits; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Inside a bright household registration office: the couple in their registration-day outfits sit side by side at the service counter, she holding her bouquet; on the counter a pen, a form and a red seal stamp with an ink pad; a friendly clerk, a simple clay figure, smiles behind the counter. All papers are blank. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
